budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average minimum cost to move a property through Land Court foreclosure is stated as $3,500.
budget_items.quote: the average minimum cost to move a property through the land court foreclosure process is $3,500.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town currently budgets $8,000 per year for tax title foreclosures, about two properties.
budget_items.quote: currently the town only budgets $8,000 per year for tax title foreclosures (approximately two properties).

budget_items.topic: Cost and impact of foreclosing Conservation Commission-interest properties
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Foreclosing the properties of Conservation Commission interest would cost $56,000, create about $180,000 in abated taxes and reduce the Tax Levy by $1,208,400.
budget_items.quote: it would cost the town $56,000 to foreclose, create a deficit of approximately $180,000 in abated taxes and reduction of $1,208,400

budget_items.topic: Taxes owed on Town-owned foreclosed properties
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Four foreclosed properties owned by the Town carry taxes owed going back to 1983, 1988, 1990 and 1993.
budget_items.quote: currently the town owns four foreclosed properties:

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Interest at 16% is not accruing during the foreclosure process.
budget_items.quote: during the foreclosure process, it is not accruing the 16% interest.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The plan to consolidate municipal offices into T.C. Passios has an estimated cost of $4.7 million with no current funding.
budget_items.quote: there is an estimated cost of $4.7 million, which has no funding currently.

budget_items.topic: Rent from T.C. Passios during transition
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Delaying the demolition of a Passios wing was discussed as a way to generate rent during the transition period; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: we have since said maybe we want to wait on that in order to generate rent during the transition period.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed a payroll deductions warrant, a payroll warrant and an accounts payable warrant.
budget_items.quote: the board signed a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $517,670.97, a payroll warrant in the amount of $690,311.68 and an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $881,422.04.

budget_items.quote: there was a transfer from the surplus in the school electricity line account of $45,000 to the capital improvement line account to be used for security equipment at the primary school.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Committee accepted $1600 in donations from Hannaford's and Fitchburg State University's professors.
budget_items.quote: they accepted $1600 in donations from hannaford's and fitchburg state university's professors.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The applicant is waiving the event fee for Thursday to encourage early arrival; no dollar figure printed.
